_about: Downed runners and NPC teammates (game/revive.rs). A runner who would die goes down instead, and a downed body is revived by a teammate holding interact beside it. No item is needed. A remote human teammate counts as a helper while its newest sample (at most remote_sample_max_age_s old) says it holds interact on this runner within reach and within reach_height metres of height. Distances are metres on the floor, times are seconds.
